newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Banco Ganadero Q1 profit drops.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Banco Ganadero Q1 profit drops.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 29, Reuters - Colombia's Banco Ganadero SA 0.8 percent to 14 billion pesos.
Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets, said in a statement that its first-quarter earnings compared with profit of 14.2 billion pesos in the same period in 1996.

The bank said the decline in the most recent quarter reflected higher personnel and general operating costs. It also said it raised provisions to cover bad debt by 32.6 percent amid continued uncertainty in the national economy.

At the end of the first quarter, Ganadero's total assets stood at more than 3.8 trillion pesos, or 23.1 percent higher than at the end of the 1996 first quarter, when it had total assets of 3.08 trillion pesos.
